title: 第十七课 · 去动物园
subtitle: Lesson 17 — 去动物园 · Going to the Zoo

items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
items.en: The weather has been fine in the last two days.
Where shall we go for fun?

items.zh: 去北海公园看看花儿，划划船。
items.py: Qù Běihǎi Gōngyuán kànkan huār, huáhua chuán.
items.en: Let's go to Beihai Park to see the flowers and go boating.

items.py: Tā shàngwǔ dào háishi xiàwǔ dào?
items.en: Will he arrive in the morning or in the afternoon?
How do I get to the zoo?

items.zh: 先坐地铁，再换公共汽车。
items.py: Xiān zuò dìtiě, zài huàn gōnggòng qìchē.
items.en: First take the subway, then transfer to a bus.

items.zh: 不太远，坐车二十分钟就到了。
items.py: Bú tài yuǎn, zuò chē èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
items.en: Not too far, 20 minutes by bus.
Which bus number do you take?

items.zh: 张丽英：这两天天气很好。我们出去玩儿玩儿吧。
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì hěn hǎo. Wǒmen chūqù wánr wánr ba.
items.en: Zhang Liying: The weather has been great these last couple of days. Let's go for an outing.

items.py: Hézǐ: Qù nǎr wánr hǎo ne?

items.zh: 张丽英：去北海公园，看看花儿，划划船，多好啊！
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Qù Běihǎi Gōngyuán, kànkan huār, huáhua chuán, duō hǎo a!
items.en: Zhang Liying: Let's go to Beihai Park, see the flowers and go boating. How lovely!

items.zh: 和子：上星期我去过了，去别的地方吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shàng xīngqī wǒ qù guò le, qù bié de dìfang ba.
items.en: Hezi: I went there last week. Let's go somewhere else.

items.zh: 张丽英：去动物园怎么样？
items.en: Zhang Liying: How about the zoo?

items.zh: 和子：行，还可以看看大熊猫呢。
items.py: Hézǐ: Xíng, hái kěyǐ kànkan dàxióngmāo ne.
items.en: Hezi: Sure, we can also see the pandas.
Zhang Liying: How shall we get there?

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (Picking Up Li Chengri)

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ rènshi Lǐ Chéngrì ma?
items.en: Hezi: Do you know Li Chengri?

items.zh: 刘京：当然认识。去年他在这儿学过汉语。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dāngrán rènshi. Qùnián tā zài zhèr xué guò Hànyǔ.
items.en: Liu Jing: Of course. He studied Chinese here last year.

items.zh: 和子：你知道吗？明天他来北京。
items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Míngtiān tā lái Běijīng.
items.en: Hezi: Did you know? He's coming to Beijing tomorrow.

items.zh: 刘京：不知道。他上午到还是下午到？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bù zhīdào. Tā shàngwǔ dào háishi xiàwǔ dào?
items.en: Liu Jing: No, I didn't. Is he arriving in the morning or the afternoon?

items.zh: 和子：下午两点，我去机场接他。
items.py: Hézǐ: Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē tā.
items.en: Hezi: 2 PM. I'm going to the airport to pick him up.

items.zh: 刘京：明天下午没有课，我跟你一起去。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Míngtiān xiàwǔ méi yǒu kè, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù.
items.en: Liu Jing: I don't have class tomorrow afternoon. I'll go with you.
Liu Jing: When shall we leave?

data.topic: 会话3 · Dialogue 3 (Asking Directions to the Zoo)

items.zh: 大卫：请问，去动物园怎么走？
items.py: Dàwèi: Qǐngwèn, qù dòngwùyuán zěnme zǒu?
items.en: David: Excuse me, how do I get to the zoo?

items.zh: 路人：你可以坐公共汽车去。
items.py: Lùrén: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù.
items.en: Passerby: You can take the bus.

items.py: Dàwèi: Lí zhèr yuǎn bu yuǎn?
items.en: David: Is it far from here?

items.zh: 路人：不太远，坐车二十分钟就到了。
items.py: Lùrén: Bú tài yuǎn, zuò chē èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
items.en: Passerby: Not too far, 20 minutes by bus.
David: Where is the bus stop?

items.zh: 路人：往前走，到十字路口往右拐就是。
items.py: Lùrén: Wǎng qián zǒu, dào shízì lùkǒu wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì.
items.en: Passerby: Go straight ahead, turn right at the crossroads.

items.zh: 玛丽：请问，去天安门怎么走？
items.py: Mǎlì: Qǐngwèn, qù Tiān'ānmén zěnme zǒu?
items.en: Mary: Excuse me, how do I get to Tiananmen?

items.zh: 路人：你先坐地铁到西直门，再换二号线。
items.py: Lùrén: Nǐ xiān zuò dìtiě dào Xīzhímén, zài huàn èr hào xiàn.
items.en: Passerby: First take the subway to Xizhimen, then transfer to Line 2.
Mary: Where is the subway station?

items.zh: 路人：往前走五分钟就到了。
items.py: Lùrén: Wǎng qián zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
items.en: Passerby: Walk forward for 5 minutes and you'll be there.

items.zh: 玛丽：也可以坐出租车去吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Yě kěyǐ zuò chūzū chē qù ma?
items.en: Mary: Can I also take a taxi?

items.zh: 路人：可以，可是现在路上车太多了。
items.py: Lùrén: Kěyǐ, kěshì xiànzài lù shang chē tài duō le.
items.en: Passerby: Yes, but there's too much traffic right now.

items.zh: 玛丽：那我还是坐地铁吧。谢谢！
items.py: Mǎlì: Nà wǒ háishi zuò dìtiě ba. Xièxie!
items.en: Mary: Then I'd better take the subway. Thanks!

data.topic: 替换与扩展 · Substitution and Extension

items.zh: 这两天天气很好。——这两天小王身体不好。
items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì hěn hǎo. —— Zhè liǎng tiān Xiǎo Wáng shēntǐ bù hǎo.
items.en: The weather has been fine. — Xiao Wang hasn't been well recently.

items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān tāmen yǒu kǎoshì.

items.zh: 这两天坐地铁的人很多。
items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān zuò dìtiě de rén hěn duō.
items.en: There have been a lot of people taking the subway recently.

items.zh: 看看花儿，划划船，多好啊！
items.py: Kànkan huār, huáhua chuán, duō hǎo a!
items.en: See the flowers and go boating, how lovely!

items.zh: 他上午到还是下午到？——你去机场还是他去机场？
items.py: Tā shàngwǔ dào háishi xiàwǔ dào? —— Nǐ qù jīchǎng háishi tā qù jīchǎng?
items.en: Morning or afternoon arrival? — Are you going to the airport or is he?

items.zh: 下星期走还是下下星期走？
items.py: Xià xīngqī zǒu háishi xià xià xīngqī zǒu?
items.en: Leaving next week or the week after?

items.zh: 今年回国还是明年回国？
items.py: Jīnnián huí guó háishi míngnián huí guó?
items.en: Going home this year or next year?
How to get to the zoo?
How to get to the train station?
How to get to the hospital?

items.py: Wǒ měi tiān qí zìxíngchē shàng xué.
items.en: I ride a bicycle to school every day.

items.zh: 从这儿到学校坐车要多长时间？
items.py: Cóng zhèr dào xuéxiào zuò chē yào duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: How long does it take by bus from here to school?

items.py: Zǒu lù qù tài yuǎn le.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (选择疑问句 · Alternative Questions with 还是)

items.py: Tā shàngwǔ dào háishi xiàwǔ dào?
items.en: Is he arriving in the morning or the afternoon?

items.py: Nǐ shàngwǔ qù háishi xiàwǔ qù?
items.en: Are you going in the morning or the afternoon?

items.py: Nǐ hē kāfēi háishi hē chá?
items.en: Do you want coffee or tea?

items.zh: 你一个人去还是跟朋友一起去？
items.py: Nǐ yī gè rén qù háishi gēn péngyou yìqǐ qù?
items.en: Are you going alone or with friends?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (连动句 · Serial Verb Constructions for Manner)

items.en: Go by bike. (first verb shows manner of second verb)

items.py: Shàng kè le, kuài jìnlái ba.
items.en: Class is starting, come in quickly. (speaker is inside)

items.py: Tā bú zài jiā, chūqù le.
items.en: He's not home, he went out. (speaker is at home)
Mary, come down quickly! (speaker is downstairs)

items.zh: 先坐地铁，再换公共汽车。
items.py: Xiān zuò dìtiě, zài huàn gōnggòng qìchē.
items.en: First take the subway, then transfer to a bus.

items.py: Xiān wǎng qián zǒu, zài wǎng yòu guǎi.
items.en: First go straight, then turn right.

items.py: Xiān chī fàn, ránhòu qù shàng kè.
items.en: First eat, then go to class.

items.py: Xiān xiě zuòyè, zài kàn diànshì.
items.en: First do homework, then watch TV.

items.zh: 你六点半起床还是七点起床？
items.py: Nǐ liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng háishi qī diǎn qǐchuáng?
items.en: Do you get up at 6:30 or 7:00? (practice with 还是)

items.zh: 你去机场还是他去机场？
items.py: Nǐ qù jīchǎng háishi tā qù jīchǎng?
items.en: Are you going to the airport or is he?

items.zh: 今年回国还是明年回国？
items.py: Jīnnián huí guó háishi míngnián huí guó?
items.en: Are you going home this year or next year?

items.zh: 王兰告诉我，离我们学校不远有一个果园，那儿有很多水果，可以看，可以吃，也可以买。
items.py: Wáng Lán gàosu wǒ, lí wǒmen xuéxiào bù yuǎn yǒu yī gè guǒyuán, nàr yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ, kěyǐ kàn, kěyǐ chī, yě kěyǐ mǎi.
items.en: (Retelling) Wang Lan told me there's an orchard not far from our school, with lots of fruit you can see, eat, and buy.

items.zh: 我们应该去看看。我们想星期天去。我们骑自行车去。
items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù kànkan. Wǒmen xiǎng xīngqītiān qù. Wǒmen qí zìxíngchē qù.
items.en: (Retelling) We should go have a look. We're thinking of going on Sunday. We'll go by bike.
